raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer misidentified the correct Anna of Hungary by selecting the Britannica entry for Anna (daughter of Béla IV and Maria Laskarina) rather than Anna of Hungary, the Byzantine empress (daughter of Stephen V and Elizabeth the Cuman). This failure to disambiguate similarly named historical figures and to cross-verify against the context (Andronikos II’s wife) led to the incorrect conclusion that Maria Laskarina was the maternal grandmother, instead of the correct Elizabeth the Cuman.
